hypothesis: First verify exact feasible world/fullstate source transcription on a reset-reachable saved551 segment, without periodicity. Only then inspect one constrained common-space arrival-time improvement direction.
selection: First551 tracking before-action progress>=existing533station37, no outcome selection; optimize first6holds, fixed next2follow, fixed ninth control ONLY as late-crossing measurement buffer. The same physical planes at saved6/8hold endpoints; no558 target or synthetic state.
transcription: For each of9 holds, independently source-propagate saved node+saved float32 action and compare ALL4raw fullroot excluding immutable roads, INCLUDING contacts/pose/gas/omega/joints and forces EXACTLY. Then sequential36raw replay must match every saved fullstate and force. Canonical tuple/list normalization only. Any mismatch stops before sensitivity/time study.
representation: Saved hold nodes with exact zero defects; source-condensed forward state sensitivities of12 controls. No periodicity condition, no arbitrary target state/time or world-frame quotient.

direction.variables: First6holds x steering and signed pedal; final3controls fixed. One LP minimizing average arrival time to the two frozen physical planes. No basis/window/step sweep or repeated nonlinear solve.
direction.finite_difference: 12 one-sided source rollouts, steering step1e-5/pedal1e-4; direction chosen inside action bounds and SAME brake-lock/pedal branch; divide by actual float32 perturbation. Source geometry and all world state responses included.
direction.trust_box: steering delta<=.002rad,pedal delta<=.02, existing +/-float32(.4) and[-1,1] and same pedal/lock branch. These are finite design choices, not physical necessity.
direction.LP: Keep half the baseline slack in linearized constraints G*delta>=-.5*g0; constraints include all raw safety, no NEW clipped samples vs frozen baseline mask, two-sided world/fullstate gate-state comparison tolerances, and both plane arrival times nonworsening. ZERO delta must be feasible. One scipy HiGHS linprog; select full solution as ONE candidate, no backtracking.
direction.candidate_gate: All real source raw safety; primary+follow interpolated gains each>=5ms and full gate comparison tolerances. Report raw crossing brackets and interpolation convention; no native or full-lap gain inference. Even effect failure retains transcription evidence.

safety: source footprint>=.50,path<=3,ORIGINAL551reference overspeed<=4.85,preclip force<=1.059,hull/allwheel<100,cumulative clipping<=10% INCLUDING true saved tracking history. No-new-clip LP mask is conservative design only. All trial model body hard100. Unsafe finite-difference/trial forecasts counted, never actual execution.
gate_measurement: First forward plane crossing within36raw, signed plane interpolation defines model time. Interpolate numeric world state solely as a comparison metric between raw states; it is NOT a physically reachable intermediate source state. Record exact raw brackets and preserve ALL actual raw safety. World position tolerance components.1m plus Euclidean<=.15,angle.02,velocity components.15,yaw.05,M=I*.05,omega.5,gas/joints.02,rates.15,heading.02,offset.15,lever.1; unchanged friction/constants. Contact IDs compared exactly for transcription, logged separately for changed trajectory.
stop: Mismatch -> no time experiment. FD crossing not bracketed/LP failure -> stop classification, no alternate direction. Candidate failure -> stop with full record, no smaller step/other controls. Deadline/domain/cost -> checkpoint and no rerun.
